_: The settings of the adapter. There is one service here and it is its own - it owns the microphone and rides inside this very mod. There are no models here: each one arrives as a mod of its own and puts a listing into the models folder next to this file.

ears._: The microphone and the cutting of speech into passes. Every number here was tuned in the game; the defaults are built into the plugin and this block is written out on first run, so a key that is missing is not a mistake. 16000 Hz is NOT here and must not be added: the contract fixes it, and changing it would hand every installed model a buffer it declared it cannot take.

capture._: Where the sound comes from. source 'file' makes a wav stand in for the microphone, so the whole of this half can be tried outside the game; the path is relative to the folder of the adapter and may not leave it. blockMs is a request - WASAPI in shared mode gives the period it likes.

device._: Names, not numbers: indices are not stable between reboots and names are. Best first; a pattern is a case-insensitive part of the name of the endpoint. inputApi is kept from the settings of the python this was ported from - here there is only WASAPI, and a name that is not it is reported once rather than obeyed in silence.

vad._: What silence sounds like and when speech has started. The floor is measured once, at the start, and never adjusted afterwards: speech raises the level, so a threshold that followed it would climb after the speaker and stop telling one from the other. Do not speak while it is measured. maxUttSec has a second duty - it is the largest buffer that can ever be sent to a model.

pacer._: When the models are asked. A short pause fires a pass and costs nothing when there is no pause; endSilenceMs is what ends a speaking turn; maxSpanMs is for somebody who never pauses at all.

turn._: The tolerances of a turn. The anchors are the edges of the pauses, measured from the sound alone, and the slacks say how far a model's timing may be from one and still be called the same place.

prosody._: Our own measurement of the tone, which the punctuation of a recogniser is no substitute for: its punctuation is three quarters language, and a fall to the bottom of the speaker's own range is a measurement.

completeness._: Whether the sentence finished on this piece. The pause is weighed against the speaker's own tempo rather than against a fixed number of milliseconds.

segments._: Where short, middle and long part company, in words.
